dogecoin.text:
3/ Famous Meme Coins:

    Dogecoin (DOGE): Started as a joke in 2013; now worth ~$0.36.
    Shiba Inu (SHIB): Dubbed the "Dogecoin killer," it became a massive sensation.
    These coins showed the world how a joke could become a financial phenomenon.

2/ What Are Meme Coins? 🤔
Meme coins are cryptocurrencies inspired by internet culture and jokes. Think Dogecoin (DOGE) or Shiba Inu (SHIB). They thrive on community hype, often lacking real-world utility.
🚨 High potential for gains (and losses).
